title: UAPx becomes Project X at University at Albany

plain: A research group called UAPx, set up to study UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), was dissolved at some point after 2020 and moved to the University at Albany in New York, where it now runs as Project X. Kevin Knuth, a scientist billed on the episode as a NASA whistleblower and who took part in the original group, says so, naming Matthew Szydagis, Cecilia Levy and Tony Gorman in connection with it. If so, the study of such sightings has found a home in a university.
